source.reference: Windows Electron source checkout; M3D20-10 observed runs on 2026-11-11
source.derivation: Ceiling of the highest observed p95 or sampled RSS across baseline, after-worker and final source profiles, plus 20%, rounded up to a practical 50 or 100 unit boundary. These are regression thresholds, not installed release claims.

longMemory.reference: Windows i9-12900K source build, continuous 100-action cycles for at least two hours
longMemory.derivation: The short-run 1500 MiB ceiling plus 548 MiB headroom, with at most 64 MiB late-window growth; GPU and renderer-private ceilings are separate native-memory safeguards. This is a predeclared acceptance target, not a measurement or installed budget.

installed.reason: No clean installed 2.0 candidate has been measured on this reference device. Require a package hash, installed-host receipt, repeat runs and a separately frozen budget.
